title: Transcription start sites of Escherichia coli K-12 MG1655 at single-base resolution by Cappable-seq (16,359 sites, grown in M9 minimal medium with glucose), with the genome sequence their coordinates refer to (U00096.2)
provider: Ettwiller, Buswell, Yigit and Schildkraut (New England Biolabs), BMC Genomics 17, 199 (2016), Additional file 1; the genome from NCBI GenBank through the E-utilities (efetch)
credit: Transcription start sites: Ettwiller et al. 2016 (Cappable-seq)
format: ettwiller-2016-tss.gtf: GTF-like, tab-separated, one site per line: the sequence (gi|48994873|gb|U00096.2|), the source CAPPABLE_SEQ, the type TSS, start = end = the site (1-based), the relative read score (RRS, the site's reads per million against the region's), the strand, '.', and an identifier. U00096.2.fasta: the genome the sites are placed on (4,639,675 bp), the version before NC_000913.3's corrections, so that the sites' windows are read without a liftover.
coverage: The whole genome, both strands; sites with RRS of at least 1.5 (the paper's threshold)
licence: The article and its additional files: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), (c) Ettwiller et al. 2016; the genome: NCBI places no restrictions on the use or distribution of GenBank data (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/).
citation: Ettwiller, L., Buswell, J., Yigit, E. and Schildkraut, I. (2016), A novel enrichment strategy reveals unprecedented number of novel transcription start sites at single base resolution in a model prokaryote and the gut microbiome, BMC Genomics 17, 199, doi:10.1186/s12864-016-2539-z; Blattner, F. R. et al. (1997), The complete genome sequence of Escherichia coli K-12, Science 277, 1453-1462.
used_by: domains/genomics (regulation: sigma-70 promoter models learnt from transcription start sites, and their checks)
